From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From vèncer +‎ -dor.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central) [bən.səˈðo]
  • IPA(key): (Balearic) [vən.səˈðo]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [ven.seˈðoɾ]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)

Adjective

[edit]

vencedor (feminine vencedora, masculine plural vencedors, feminine plural vencedores)

  1. winning

Noun

[edit]

vencedor m (plural vencedors, feminine vencedora, feminine plural vencedores)

  1. winner, victor

Further reading

[edit]
  • “vencedor”, in Diccionari de la llengua catalana [Dictionary of the Catalan Language] (in Catalan), second edition, Institute of Catalan Studies [Catalan: Institut d'Estudis Catalans], April 2007
  • “vencedor”, in Gran Diccionari de la Llengua Catalana, Grup Enciclopèdia Catalana, 2026
  • “vencedor” in Diccionari normatiu valencià, Acadèmia Valenciana de la Llengua.
  • “vencedor” in Diccionari català-valencià-balear, Antoni Maria Alcover and Francesc de Borja Moll, 1962.

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From vencer +‎ -dor.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /vẽ.seˈdoʁ/ [vẽ.seˈdoh]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /vẽ.seˈdoʁ/ [vẽ.seˈdoh]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /vẽ.seˈdoɾ/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /vẽ.seˈdoʁ/ [vẽ.seˈdoχ]
    • (Caipira) IPA(key): /vẽ.seˈdoɻ/
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /vẽ.sɨˈdoɾ/ [vẽ.sɨˈðoɾ]
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /vẽ.sɨˈdoɾ/ [vẽ.sɨˈðoɾ]
    • (Northern Portugal) IPA(key): /bẽ.sɨˈdoɾ/ [bẽ.sɨˈðoɾ]
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /vẽ.sɨˈdo.ɾi/ [vẽ.sɨˈðo.ɾi]

  • Hyphenation: ven‧ce‧dor

Noun

[edit]

vencedor m (plural vencedores, feminine vencedora, feminine plural vencedoras)

  1. winner (one who has won or often wins), victor
    Synonym: ganhador

Related terms

[edit]
  • vencer
  • vencido

Further reading

[edit]
  • “vencedor”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “vencedor”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From vencer +‎ -dor. Compare Portuguese vencedor, Italian vincitore, French vainqueur.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /benθeˈdoɾ/ [bẽn̟.θeˈð̞oɾ] (Equatorial Guinea, Spain)
  • IPA(key): /benseˈdoɾ/ [bẽn.seˈð̞oɾ] (Latin America, Philippines)
  • Rhymes: -oɾ
  • Syllabification: ven‧ce‧dor

Adjective

[edit]

vencedor (feminine vencedora, masculine plural vencedores, feminine plural vencedoras)

  1. conquering
  2. winning, defeating, vanquishing

Noun

[edit]

vencedor m (plural vencedores, feminine vencedora, feminine plural vencedoras)

  1. conquerer
    Synonym: conquistador
  2. victor, winner

Related terms

[edit]
  • vencer

Further reading

[edit]
  • “vencedor”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025
